mapper.update: UPDATE job_applications SET applicant_name = #{applicantName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, email = #{email}, activity_region = #{activityRegion}, futsal_experience = #{futsalExperience}, motivation = #{motivation}, cv_path = #{cvPath} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.select: SELECT application_id AS applicationId, applicant_name AS applicantName, birth_date AS birthDate, phone_number AS phoneNumber, email, activity_region AS activityRegion, futsal_experience AS futsalExperience, motivation, cv_path AS cvPath, created_at AS createdAt FROM job_applications ORDER BY application_id DESC

SELECT application_id AS applicationId, applicant_name AS applicantName, birth_date AS birthDate, phone_number AS phoneNumber, email, activity_region AS activityRegion, futsal_experience AS futsalExperience, motivation, cv_path AS cvPath, created_at AS createdAt FROM job_applications WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT application_id AS applicationId, applicant_name AS applicantName, birth_date AS birthDate, phone_number AS phoneNumber, email, activity_region AS activityRegion, futsal_experience AS futsalExperience, motivation, cv_path AS cvPath, created_at AS createdAt FROM job_applications WHERE (email IS NOT NULL AND email = #{email}) OR (phone_number IS NOT NULL AND phone_number = #{phone}) ORDER BY application_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
